name: Prefect Open-Source Server Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Python workflow orchestration with self-hosted Prefect server/UI, scheduled deployments, retries, caching and event-driven flows; no vendor-imposed local server run quota.
watch_out: Self-host the API/server, workers, database and task infrastructure; hosting, compute, storage and third-party integrations can cost money. Prefect Cloud managed plans and enterprise features are separate; this is not a free managed cloud allowance.
